other_failure_modes.name: Data leakage via full-dataset aggregations
other_failure_modes.description: The agent calculates grouped aggregations and frequency encodings on the combined train and test dataset. This causes test set distribution statistics to leak into the training features.

summary: The agent performs extensive preprocessing and feature engineering but critically suffers from data leakage by applying TF-IDF, SVD, and grouped aggregations on the combined train and test dataset before splitting. Additionally, it ignores the temporal nature of the dataset by using a random K-fold split, and relies on a naive equal-weight ensemble without tuning.
